findings.claim: From now on, every new general grant writes a reason="..." field to the ledger, and when the person gives no reason it writes the default "no reason given". An engine built before this unit does not know the reason key, so it refuses a ledger that holds such a line. The new --reason usage line does not repeat the rebuild warning that the general-grant and --classes lines carry.
findings.evidence: internal/goal/root.go: renderAttorneyEntry writes reason= whenever Reason is set, and intent_grant_everything.go always sets it, to the default if needed. The old parser's parseKVRecord only accepts a fixed list of keys. The existing usage text already tells the person to rebuild every seat's engine before the first general grant, and landing deploys to both seats. The slice works and is safe without a change, so this is noted only.
findings.change: Optionally, add 'older engines refuse a ledger that holds one' to the --reason usage line.
